summary: Frontend-only admin panel testing completed across required routes and core UI flows. Most routes render, but three critical interaction issues were found.

ui_bugs.issue: Create buttons do not open blog editor drawer; row edit opens it successfully.
Mobile menu button click does not open sidebar overlay via user click; JS click opens it.
Theme toggle click does not apply dark mode class or visible theme change.

issues: Not all interactive elements have data-testid (e.g., '+ Add tag' button in blog tag input).

action_items: Fix blogs create and topbar primary action wiring so drawer opens from create actions.
Fix mobile menu clickability/overlay trigger in real user click path.
Implement working dark mode state application (class strategy and visual token switch).
Add missing data-testid attributes to all remaining interactive controls.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout topbar primary action button has no onClick handler; action appears non-functional.
Dark mode state toggles internally but no effective UI state change is reflected.
Critical actions should be validated with explicit interaction tests to prevent dead CTA regressions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified route rendering for /admin redirect, login, forgot-password, dashboard, blogs, courses, batches, faculties, branches, toppers, coupons, metadata-editor, user-management, institute-settings. Reproduced non-functional create action and mobile menu click issues. Row edit reliably opens blog editor drawer, indicating drawer component itself works.
rca of the issue: RCA summary: (1) Create flow issue is likely action wiring/event targeting mismatch because drawer state opens from row-edit but not from create CTAs. (2) Mobile menu likely has click interception/stacking issue since programmatic DOM click works but pointer click does not. (3) Dark mode toggle likely not connected to effective global theme class strategy, observed no dark wrapper/class change and no computed color change. Mitigation: verify click targets/z-index, bind primary actions to drawer open handlers, and apply dark class at app root consumed by Tailwind dark variants.
